description: This file defines interfaces, utility functions, and constants for cloud provider integration within Kubernetes, including load balancer, instance, zone, routing, and metadata handling.

classes.name: ControllerClientBuilder
classes.description: Interface for obtaining cloud controller clients and configurations.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Abstract interface for cloud provider functionalities such as load balancer, instances, zones, clusters, and routes.

classes.name: Clusters
classes.description: Interface for managing container clusters, listing cluster names and retrieving master node addresses.

classes.name: LoadBalancer
classes.description: Interface for managing load balancer resources, including creation, update, retrieval, and deletion.

classes.name: Instances
classes.description: Interface for managing cloud instances, retrieving addresses, IDs, types, and managing SSH keys.

classes.name: InstancesV2
classes.description: Enhanced interface for external cloud providers to manage instances, including metadata and existence checks.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents an advanced routing rule in the cloud provider.

classes.name: Routes
classes.description: Interface for managing routing rules, including listing, creating, and deleting routes.

classes.name: InstanceMetadata
classes.description: Contains metadata about a specific cloud instance, such as ProviderID, type, addresses, zone, and region.

methods.name: DefaultLoadBalancerName
methods.description: Generates a default name for a load balancer based on the service UID, compatible with GCE and AWS naming constraints.

methods.name: GetInstanceProviderID
methods.description: Constructs a provider-specific ID for a node, returning errors if instances cannot be retrieved.
